notes: A tool name the mapping table does not know. Default-deny-unknown is a policy decision, not an internal error, so the expectation is a deny response at exit 0 on both providers - matching the Copilot twin (copilot/unknown-tool); the fail-closed exit codes are reserved for the runner being unable to decide at all (corrupt state, unreadable request). The T5 outcome row must name unknown tool names as a policy deny. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
